one_line_purpose: An n8n workflow that analyzes job descriptions and resumes to provide a fit score, skill gap analysis, and personalized application advice using AI.
problem_solved: Job seekers waste time applying to mismatched roles. This workflow solves this by taking a job description and resume, extracting skills using AI, scoring the match deterministically, and producing a personalized gap analysis or application advice.
architecture_summary: The workflow is triggered by a public web form collecting job description and resume text. It then uses Google Gemini 2.5 Flash to extract skills from both inputs. A deterministic JavaScript code node compares the extracted skills to calculate a match score and identify missing skills. Based on a predefined score threshold, an IF node routes the workflow to one of two paths: a 'strong fit' path for tailored application advice or a 'weak fit' path for a skill gap analysis, both generated by Google Gemini 2.5 Flash using different personas. Finally, the structured report, including score, matched skills, missing skills, and personalized advice, is returned to the user.
key_features: AI-powered skill extraction from job descriptions and resumes
Deterministic match scoring and skill gap identification
Personalized application advice or upskilling roadmap based on fit score
Web form as a public user interface and trigger
Structured JSON output from AI models for reliable downstream processing
Conditional branching logic based on match score
Dynamic AI persona switching (skill extractor, application coach, gap analyst)
Workflow exposed as a callable tool via n8n Form Trigger
notable_code_decisions: Using Google Gemini 2.5 Flash for tasks requiring language understanding and generation (skill extraction, advice generation).
Employing a deterministic JavaScript code node for reproducible and auditable match scoring, emphasizing correctness over AI for critical calculations.
Designing LLM prompts to enforce structured JSON outputs for reliable data parsing.
Implementing conditional routing (IF node) to tailor responses based on specific business logic (fit score threshold).
Separating AI roles/personas (neutral extractor vs. personalized advisor) through distinct prompts for the same model.
Mapping raw text inputs (JD, Resume) to structured skill sets before comparison.
tradeoffs_and_limitations: Reliance on the quality and consistency of the AI model (Gemini 2.5 Flash) for accurate skill extraction and relevant advice generation, which may still involve potential for hallucination or misinterpretation.
The skill scoring mechanism in the JavaScript node is based on basic string matching (includes operator) which might not capture semantic similarity or skill hierarchy effectively.
The generated '30-day learning plan' for weak fits is general AI-generated advice, not a deeply personalized curriculum based on real-time learning resources or a comprehensive user profile.
The solution's scalability and performance would be dependent on the n8n instance and Google Gemini API rate limits.
what_it_demonstrates: This repository demonstrates building an agentic AI workflow using a low-code orchestration platform (n8n). It highlights the effective combination of AI (LLMs) for ambiguous tasks like extraction and generation, with deterministic code for critical, reproducible logic like scoring and routing. It also showcases prompt engineering techniques for structured outputs, persona-based AI interactions, conditional workflow execution, and exposing a complex process as a user-friendly tool.
